definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the exact constructor term named collectLoopBody; it introduces syntax rather than an additional execution or mathematical fact.
definitions.text:
rule collectLoopBody
    => If(
         Compare(Name("value"), CmpOp("==", Name("digit"))),
         Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("result"), "append"), Name("name"), .Exprs))
           .Stmts,
         .Stmts)
       .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining collectDigitBody from fixed AST constructors and collectLoopBody.
definitions.text:
rule collectDigitBody
    => Assign(Name("result"), ListExpr(.Exprs))
       Assign(Name("value"), Int(0))
       For(Name("value"), Name("arr"), collectLoopBody)
       Return(Name("result"))
       .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the exact byLengthBody AST term, including the nine helper calls and list concatenations.
definitions.text:
rule byLengthBody
    => Return(
         BinOp("+",
           BinOp("+",
             BinOp("+",
               BinOp("+",
                 BinOp("+",
                   BinOp("+",
                     BinOp("+",
                       BinOp("+",
                         Call(Name("collect_digit"),
                              (Name("arr"), Int(9), Str("Nine"), .Exprs)),
                         Call(Name("collect_digit"),
                              (Name("arr"), Int(8), Str("Eight"), .Exprs))),
                       Call(Name("collect_digit"),
                            (Name("arr"), Int(7), Str("Seven"), .Exprs))),
                     Call(Name("collect_digit"),
                          (Name("arr"), Int(6), Str("Six"), .Exprs))),
                   Call(Name("collect_digit"),
                        (Name("arr"), Int(5), Str("Five"), .Exprs))),
                 Call(Name("collect_digit"),
                      (Name("arr"), Int(4), Str("Four"), .Exprs))),
               Call(Name("collect_digit"),
                    (Name("arr"), Int(3), Str("Three"), .Exprs))),
             Call(Name("collect_digit"),
                  (Name("arr"), Int(2), Str("Two"), .Exprs))),
           Call(Name("collect_digit"),
                (Name("arr"), Int(1), Str("One"), .Exprs))))
       .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining solutionModule by assembling the two named function-body terms.
definitions.text:
rule solutionModule
    => Module(
         FuncDef(
           "collect_digit",
           Params("arr", "digit", "name", .ParamNames),
           collectDigitBody)
         FuncDef(
           "by_length",
           Params("arr", .ParamNames),
           byLengthBody)
         .Stmts)

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining allInts on the empty value sequence.
Structural recurrence defining allInts on a nonempty value sequence.
definitions.text:
rule allInts(vCons(V:Val, REST:ValSeq))
    => isInt(V) andBool allInts(REST)

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining the collectAcc summary on an empty remaining sequence.
Structural recurrence defining collectAcc on a nonempty sequence, including its explicit non-integer totalization.
definitions.text:
rule collectAcc(vCons(X:Val, REST:ValSeq), D:Int, N:Val, ACC:ValSeq)
    => #if isInt(X)
       #then
         #if {X}:>Int ==Int D
         #then collectAcc(
                 REST,
                 D,
                 N,
                 valSeqConcat(ACC, vCons(N, .ValSeq)))
         #else collectAcc(REST, D, N, ACC)
         #fi
       #else collectAcc(REST, D, N, ACC)
       #fi

definitions.rationale: Equation defining byLengthVS as the concatenation of the nine digit-name collection summaries.
definitions.text:
rule byLengthVS(VS:ValSeq)
    => valSeqConcat(
         valSeqConcat(
           valSeqConcat(
             valSeqConcat(
               valSeqConcat(
                 valSeqConcat(
                   valSeqConcat(
                     valSeqConcat(
                       collectAcc(VS, 9, str(strToCodes("Nine")), .ValSeq),
                       collectAcc(VS, 8, str(strToCodes("Eight")), .ValSeq)),
                     collectAcc(VS, 7, str(strToCodes("Seven")), .ValSeq)),
                   collectAcc(VS, 6, str(strToCodes("Six")), .ValSeq)),
                 collectAcc(VS, 5, str(strToCodes("Five")), .ValSeq)),
               collectAcc(VS, 4, str(strToCodes("Four")), .ValSeq)),
             collectAcc(VS, 3, str(strToCodes("Three")), .ValSeq)),
           collectAcc(VS, 2, str(strToCodes("Two")), .ValSeq)),
         collectAcc(VS, 1, str(strToCodes("One")), .ValSeq))

source_rules.rationale: Additional guarded simplification fact about applyCmp used to refine an isInt value; Stage 1 compiles this rule before every proof and contains no prior rule-free proof of its exact statement, so it is trusted rather than separately proved.
source_rules.text:
rule applyCmp("==", V:Val, I:Int)
    => {V}:>Int ==Int I
    requires isInt(V)
    [simplification]
